title: Fixed Point
logline: A jazz quintet plays a small theme, then plays it again a little better, and again, until the improving runs away with the tune. On a paper stage a vermilion triangle keeps stepping out of itself with one more corner until it is a perfect circle that cannot stop rolling.
overall: Published on YouTube on 2026-11-17: the v3 native 4K master with the delivered description. The director watched and heard v2 and handed the agent the full revision pass that became v3. The agent checked frames and measurements only.
next: Nothing outstanding. The workspace is archived with the 4K master, stems, images, recipes and records.

scenes.title: The tune
scenes.summary: One ElevenLabs Music take built from a nine-section plan: solo horn, cautious first take, three improving takes, runaway bebop, collapse, solo piano, full band together, tag.

segments.title: Take A3 (4:30 after trim)
segments.detail: Chosen from three takes on measured structure: horn alone 0:00 to 0:20, horn out 1:40 to 2:00, piano drops out in the runaway, collapse at 2:40, solo piano to 3:20, full band to the end. Needs the director's ears. About 5.5 s of dead silence after the collapse was trimmed by the agent.

segments.title: Stems and features
segments.detail: Bass, drums, piano and horn stems; onsets, envelopes and horn pitch drive the shapes.

scenes.title: Alone
scenes.summary: 0:00 to 0:20. Cream sheet. The triangle practises three notes.

segments.title: A1 Three notes
segments.detail: Tumbles in on its corners, then lifts with each note; an ink line trails the melody.

scenes.title: The band walks in
scenes.summary: 0:20 to 0:55. Disc, rectangles and dots arrive; the triangle watches, then joins.

segments.title: B1 Rhythm section enters
segments.detail: Bass disc hops in on its notes, piano rectangles step, brush dots drift. New in v3: the triangle taps along from the side instead of standing frozen.

segments.title: B2 First take
segments.detail: The triangle joins, cautious, staying near the edge.

scenes.title: Again, better
scenes.summary: 0:55 to 1:40. Each chorus it steps out of itself with one more corner and leaves the old self behind.

segments.title: C1 Square
segments.detail: Afternoon ochre. It steps out of the triangle as a square; a tag game with the band begins.

segments.title: C2 Pentagon, hexagon
segments.detail: Hot ground, faster darts. Pentagon, then hexagon; the bass kicks the old selves along.

scenes.title: The workshop
scenes.summary: 1:40 to 2:00. Horn lays out. The rhythm section plays among the skins while the shape redraws itself off to one side.

segments.title: D1 Redrawing
segments.detail: Twenty-one more drafts in twenty seconds, a row of pale skins pushing the band left. v3: every redraw lands on a measured drum hit (the director's off-beat note), and the shape no longer twitches on stray sound while the horn rests.

scenes.title: Runaway
scenes.summary: 2:00 to 2:40. A perfect circle cannot stop rolling. Night palette.

segments.title: E1 It rolls
segments.detail: The world scrolls. It bowls through a road of old drafts, scatters the piano twice and flattens the bass. v3: the night backdrop is three plates cross-faded, so the mirrored sky seams are gone.

segments.title: E2 It climbs
segments.detail: Rises with the horn's top register, faster and larger.

segments.title: F1 Break
segments.detail: Shards on a blank sheet. New in v3: in the quiet, one last piece falls over and the dots flinch.

scenes.title: Aftermath
scenes.summary: 2:40 to 3:14. Solo piano. The rectangles gather the pieces and the old skins.

segments.title: G1 Gathering
segments.detail: Four piano phrases, four rectangles, each pushing one old draft home while the notes nudge the shards together.

scenes.title: Together
scenes.summary: 3:14 to 4:15. The band builds it again out of every earlier draft, nested.

segments.title: H1 Rebuilding
segments.detail: Triangle inside square inside pentagon inside hexagon inside circle.

segments.title: H2 The theme, together
segments.detail: The triangle and then the square climb out to dance on top; later both stack as a totem; the bass jumps over. v3: the nest is a little smaller so the totem stays in frame (v2 cut the triangle off), and in the last chorus the drafts wind up and stop dead, aligned, on the final hit.

segments.title: I1 The fixed point
segments.detail: Last bass note; the title, larger and a second earlier in v3.

decisions.title: Does take A3 sound right?
decisions.detail: Decided 2026-11-16. Director, after watching and listening to v2: 'I loved it. Really enjoyed the climax. Wonderful work.' and 'The beats did mostly feel on.' Take A3 stays.

decisions.title: No generated video
decisions.detail: Decided 2026-11-16 by delegation ('This is your piece now'). The agent kept it all programmatic: no generated video.

decisions.title: Title: Fixed Point
decisions.detail: Decided 2026-11-16 by delegation ('This is your piece now'). The title stays Fixed Point.

decisions.title: Silence after the collapse shortened
decisions.detail: Decided 2026-11-16 by delegation. The 5.5 s trim stays; v3 puts a small gag in the quiet that remains.

log.text: Brief written. Three song takes generated; A3 chosen on measured structure. Stems separated and analysed. Status page created.
Twelve textures and backdrops generated. Renderer written; draft v2 assembled (4:30.5) with the join pass recorded. Awaiting the director's watch and listen.
Director watched and heard v2: 'I loved it.' Noted off-beat hits at 1:42 to 1:55 and delegated a full pass with the 4K to follow.

v3 built: workshop on the drum hits, totem back in frame, last-chorus spin, late-falling shard, tapping triangle, seamless night sky, larger title. Native 4K master rendered and verified; description written. Not published.
Director published the 4K master on YouTube and supplied the link: https://youtu.be/_U2DWfBjJiQ. Post-publication closeout run.
